summary: Marinda Airport serves as the primary gateway to Waisai, the capital of Raja Ampat Regency in Indonesia's Southwest Papua province. The small airfield handles limited daily turboprop flights connecting the remote archipelago to regional hubs, with most travelers continuing onward by boat to reach the world-renowned diving and snorkeling sites of the Four Kings islands.
